item.title: Kimi to Koi Suru Gakuen Kissa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Reon
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 君と恋する学園喫茶
  • 英語名: Kimi to Koi Suru Gakuen Kissa

あらすじ

One day, it was made mandatory that all students at Seikanen Academy be part of a club. Akira was among the majority of students whose school lives changed with that declaration. He was forced by his homeroom teacher to join the Café Club. However, the club would be disbanded unless there was at least five members! They were able to find enough members, but they were all extremely eccentric. The student council leader once again threatened them with dissolution… this time if their café isn’t a resounding success.

item.title: Aisare Roommate
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Reon
  • 発売日: 2014-01-31
  • スコア: 6.909999999999999/10 (63 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 愛サレるームメイト
  • 英語名: Aisare Roommate

あらすじ

The boarding school which Kotarou attends, Rokujou Gakuen, has a slightly strange system called the ‘six étoiles’ (six stars). Students are assigned ranks of 1 to 6 stars based on their grades, and their dorms change depending on their rank. At the beginning of the second term, the boy’s dormitory collapsed and the principal declared that each boy would have to share a room with a girl. It was the first time that the girls had experienced such an intimate co-ed life. Will they fall in love being in such close quarters?
